Pagination

Pagination allows users to navigate between pages of content. It displays page numbers, navigation controls, and provides context about the total number of items.

Basic Pagination

A simple pagination with numbered page links.

1 2 3 4 5
HTML
<nav class="zak-pagination" aria-label="Pagination">
    <button class="zak-pagination-item" disabled aria-label="Previous">&laquo;</button>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item active" aria-current="page">1</a>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">2</a>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">3</a>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">4</a>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">5</a>
    <button class="zak-pagination-item" aria-label="Next">&raquo;</button>
</nav>

Pagination with Icons

Use SVG icons for the previous/next buttons.

</button>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item active" aria-current="page">1</a>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">2</a>

</button>

Pagination with Active/Disabled States

Active page is highlighted, disabled controls are visually muted.

1 2 3 4 5 6 7
HTML
<!-- Active page -->
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item active" aria-current="page">3</a>

<!-- Disabled button -->
<button class="zak-pagination-item" disabled>&laquo;</button>

Pagination with Ellipsis

Use ellipsis for large page counts to collapse middle pages.

1 2 3 … 10 11 12
HTML
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">1</a>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">2</a>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">3</a>
<span class="zak-pagination-ellipsis">&hellip;</span>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">10</a>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">11</a>
<a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item">12</a>

Compact Pagination

A minimal pagination with just prev/next and page indicator.

Page 3 of 10
HTML
<nav class="zak-pagination zak-pagination-compact">
    <button class="zak-pagination-item">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
    </button>
    <span class="zak-pagination-info">Page 3 of 10</span>
    <button class="zak-pagination-item">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
    </button>
</nav>

CSS Classes

Pagination styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Pagination Container */
.zak-pagination                     /* Base pagination */
.zak-pagination-sm                  /* Small size */
.zak-pagination-lg                  /* Large size */
.zak-pagination-compact             /* Compact prev/next only */

/* Pagination Items */
.zak-pagination-item                /* Page number or nav button */
.zak-pagination-item.active         /* Active/current page */
.zak-pagination-item:disabled       /* Disabled state */

/* Helpers */
.zak-pagination-ellipsis            /* Ellipsis indicator */
.zak-pagination-info                /* Page info text (compact) */

JavaScript

Use JavaScript for interactive pagination behavior.

HTML
// Generate pagination
function createPagination(container, totalPages, currentPage) {
    container.innerHTML = '';
    // Previous button
    const prev = document.createElement('button');
    prev.className = 'zak-pagination-item';
    prev.innerHTML = '«';
    prev.disabled = currentPage === 1;
    prev.onclick = () => createPagination(container, totalPages, currentPage - 1);
    container.appendChild(prev);

    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.className = 'zak-pagination-item' + (i === currentPage ? ' active' : '');
        link.href = '#';
        if (i === currentPage) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
        link.textContent = i;
        link.onclick = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            createPagination(container, totalPages, i);
        };
        container.appendChild(link);
    }

    // Next button
    const next = document.createElement('button');
    next.className = 'zak-pagination-item';
    next.innerHTML = '»';
    next.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;
    next.onclick = () => createPagination(container, totalPages, currentPage + 1);
    container.appendChild(next);
}

createPagination(document.querySelector('.zak-pagination'), 10, 1);

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using pagination.

  • Use <nav> with aria-label="Pagination" to identify the navigation.
  • Mark the current page with aria-current="page".
  • Use disabled attribute on prev/next buttons when at boundaries.
  • Provide descriptive aria-label on prev/next buttons (e.g., "Previous page", "Next page").
  • Use semantic list markup or ARIA to convey the page structure.
  • Ensure sufficient contrast for active page indicator and text.
HTML
<nav aria-label="Pagination results">
    <button class="zak-pagination-item" disabled aria-label="Go to previous page">&laquo;</button>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item" aria-label="Go to page 1">1</a>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item active" aria-current="page" aria-label="Page 2, current page">2</a>
    <a href="#" class="zak-pagination-item" aria-label="Go to page 3">3</a>
    <button class="zak-pagination-item" aria-label="Go to next page">&raquo;</button>
</nav>
